The murder of Baldur and the horrific, eternal punishment of Loki (bound with the entrails of his own son beneath a dripping serpent) as the direct catalyst for Ragnarok
The tragic transformation of Medusa: how a violation in Athena's temple led to a devastating curse, framing her not as a monster, but as a betrayed victim of divine cruelty

The descent of Ishtar into the Underworld: her forced stripping at the seven gates of death, her execution by Ereshkigal, and the cosmic crisis caused by the sudden disappearance of love and fertility on Earth
The ultimate sacrifice of Iphigenia: Agamemnon’s agonizing decision to sacrifice his own daughter for wind to sail to Troy, sparking a multi-generational cycle of murder and bloody revenge
The agonizing death of Heracles: how a dying centaur's trick convinced his desperate wife, Deianira, to poison him with a cloak soaked in burning Hydra venom to prevent his infidelity

The tragic drowning of Antinous: how the beloved companion of Emperor Hadrian died mysteriously in the Nile, driving the ruler of the Roman world to madness, deifying his dead lover, and forcing an entire empire to worship him.

The agonizing punishment of Prometheus: not just the eagle tearing his liver, but the psychological torture of Zeus chaining him to a freezing mountain peak where he was forced to watch humanity suffer from afar while refusing to reveal the secret of Zeus's own downfall.
The horrific curse of Phineus: how a blind prophet was starved to the brink of death by Harpies who violently defiled his food every time he tried to eat, until two winged demigods hunted them down.
